item.title: EplayerX 1.2.44
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 新增画面文字规则扫描，可按自定义正则识别并跳过已缓存视频中的广告片段；在播放设置中开启。 - 详情页新增 Letterboxd 评分，并改善只有 IMDb 编号时的评分获取。 - 改善 SubHD 字幕缓存复用，减少重复下载，并在缓存被系统清理后自动重新获取。 - 修复部分离线下载视频的续播进度无法正确保存的问题。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Added on-screen text scanning with custom regular expressions to detect and skip ad segments in cached video. Enable it in playback settings. - Added Letterboxd ratings to detail pages and improved rating lookup for titles identified only by an IMDb ID. - Improved SubHD subtitle caching to reduce repeat downloads and recover when macOS clears cached files. - Fixed resume progress not being saved correctly for some downloaded videos played offline.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
